title: Listing Highlight: 50' Azimut 50 Flybridge 2016 | FORTUNATO
description: Discover the 2016 Azimut 50 Flybridge in Key Biscayne—a refined coastal cruiser with elegant Italian design, modern amenities, and exceptional charter potential.
html:
Italian Design Meets Florida Waters On This Well-Appointed 50-Foot Power Yacht

The 2016 Azimut 50 Flybridge represents the pinnacle of European yacht craftsmanship, combining Italian design sensibility with practical cruising capability. Moored in Key Biscayne, this well-maintained vessel offers discerning captains and charter operators a sophisticated platform for exploring Florida's coastal waters and beyond. Azimut's reputation for quality construction and timeless aesthetics shines throughout this 50-foot flybridge motor yacht, making it an ideal choice for those seeking both comfort and performance.

The flybridge layout is one of the defining features of this Azimut, providing an elevated outdoor entertaining space with commanding views and excellent sun exposure. The upper deck is thoughtfully designed for relaxation and socializing, with comfortable seating and unobstructed sightlines that make navigation and wildlife observation equally rewarding. Below decks, the main salon flows seamlessly from the helm station, creating an open, airy atmosphere that maximizes natural light and ventilation throughout the vessel. Accommodations aboard the 2016 Azimut 50 are designed with guest comfort in mind. The master stateroom features a generous berth and en-suite head with shower, while additional guest cabins provide flexible sleeping arrangements for extended cruises or charter operations. The galley is well-equipped with modern appliances, and the saloon dining area serves as the social heart of the vessel, ideal for entertaining or casual family gatherings.

Propulsion comes from twin diesel engines that deliver reliable, efficient performance across a range of sea conditions. The vessel's hull design balances seaworthiness with fuel efficiency, making longer passages economical while maintaining the stability and comfort expected from a yacht of this caliber. The twin-engine configuration provides redundancy and superior maneuverability in tight anchorages and marina approaches. Key Biscayne's location offers immediate access to some of Florida's most desirable cruising grounds. From here, captains can explore the shallow-water anchorages of Biscayne Bay, venture to the Florida Keys, or undertake longer passages along the Atlantic coast. The yacht's size and capabilities make it equally suited to weekend getaways and extended voyages, with the range and comfort to handle both scenarios with ease.

The 2016 Azimut 50 Flybridge combines proven Italian engineering with the practical features modern owners and charterers demand. Whether you're seeking a personal retreat, a charter investment, or a platform for serious coastal exploration, this vessel delivers on all fronts. The combination of elegant design, solid construction, and proven performance makes it a compelling choice in the 50-foot flybridge category. **Key Specifications:**

• Length: 50 feet | Twin Diesel Engines | Flybridge with Full Outdoor Entertaining Space

• Master Stateroom with En-Suite Head | Multiple Guest Cabins | Modern Galley

• Well-Maintained Condition | Ideal for Charter or Private Use | Key Biscayne Location
